speeches.speaker: Steve Fielding
speeches.brief: A bill to regulate creeping acquisitions was introduced and passed its first reading without formalities.

speeches.speaker: Steve Fielding
speeches.brief: Family First introduced the Trade Practices (Creeping Acquisitions) Amendment Bill 2007 to prohibit acquisitions over a six-year period that substantially reduce competition, arguing the Trade Practices Act must be strengthened to address creeping acquisitions such as Coles and Woolworths’ rise from 35% to 80% of the grocery market.
